effects.printed_clause: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned from hand or GY by banishing 3 DARK monsters from your GY, including at least 2 Scarstech monsters with different names.
effects.lua_implementation: EnableReviveLimit, an aux.FALSE general Special Summon condition, and a hand/GY EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC require a three-card removable DARK GY subgroup whose Scarstech subset has at least two distinct codes; operation selects and banishes exactly that subgroup as summon cost.

official_references.matched_structure: Official special-summon-only procedure coexisting with aux.FALSE general summon condition.
Special Summons from hand/GY by banishing an exact monster group as cost.

effects.printed_clause: When a card or effect is activated as Chain Link 3 or higher, this card becomes unaffected by your opponent's card effects until the end of the Chain.
effects.lua_implementation: A continuous EVENT_CHAINING field effect checks ev>=3 and registers EFFECT_IMMUNE_EFFECT on the handler, filtering effects whose owner player is the opponent and resetting with RESET_CHAIN.

official_references.matched_structure: Registers immunity with an effect-source predicate.
Current-chain event structure and RESET_CHAIN-scoped behavior.

effects.printed_clause: The following effects can only be activated as Chain Link 2 or higher.
effects.lua_implementation: Both Quick Effects require Duel.GetCurrentChain()>0 before activation, ensuring their new links are at least Chain Link 2.

official_references.matched_structure: Activation condition requires an existing Chain so the card becomes Chain Link 2 or higher.

effects.printed_clause: Once per Chain (Quick Effect): Make all Scarstech monsters you control gain 200 ATK; if activated as Chain Link 5 or higher, you can destroy 1 opponent card.
effects.lua_implementation: A RESET_CHAIN handler flag enforces once per Chain. Target stores this effect's current Chain Link. Resolution applies persistent-until-standard-reset +200 ATK to all face-up controlled Scarstechs and, when label>=5, optionally destroys one opponent card.

official_references.matched_structure: Once-per-Chain response and effect scaling from this effect's Chain Link number.
Captures this effect's Chain Link number.
Registers cumulative ATK updates after chain events.

effects.printed_clause: During your turn (Quick Effect): Target up to 2 Scarstech cards in your GY or banishment; add them to your hand.
effects.lua_implementation: A Quick Effect requires the controller's turn and an existing chain, targets one or two face-up-eligible Scarstech cards from GY/banishment through Necrovalley, then adds/confirms related targets.

official_references.matched_structure: Targets up to cards in GY/banishment with Necrovalley handling.

effects.printed_clause: You can only use this effect of Scarstech Kaiser once per turn; you can only control 1 Scarstech Kaiser.
effects.lua_implementation: Only the add effect has SetCountLimit(1,id). SetUniqueOnField enforces one controlled copy; the ATK effect is separately once per Chain.

coverage_override.reason: The six records separately cover the Special Summon-only restriction/procedure, Chain-scoped immunity, the shared Chain-Link-2 activation requirement, the once-per-Chain ATK effect with its optional Chain-Link-5 destruction follow-up, the turn-restricted recovery effect, and its once-per-turn limit plus the unique-control restriction. No printed procedure, follow-up, or limit is omitted.
